pages.title: Llama
pages.text: The llama ($(o)Lama glama$()) is a domesticated South American camelid, bred from the wild guanaco in the Andes thousands of years ago.$(br2)It is the largest of the South American camelids and has long been used as a pack animal for carrying loads across the mountains.$(br2)Llamas are social herd animals. They are also kept for their meat and wool, and as guard animals for flocks of sheep.
